disclaimer: Educational decision support only. Similar symptoms can have non-disease causes. Confirm diagnosis with a KVK, agricultural extension officer, or plant pathologist. Use only products registered for the crop and disease locally and follow the current label.

symptoms: Older leaves yellow, wilt, and collapse
Pseudostem or corm vessels turn reddish-brown
prevention: Use certified tissue-culture plants and resistant cultivars
Prevent movement of contaminated soil, water, tools, and suckers
treatment: Quarantine and report suspected TR4; follow official containment advice
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit
Diagnosis is uncertain, several plants are affected, or initial management fails

symptoms: Narrow reddish-brown streaks enlarge into dark spots
Leaves blacken and die, reducing bunch filling
prevention: Use tolerant cultivars and clean planting material
Remove badly infected leaf tissue and improve airflow and drainage
treatment: Use a resistance-managed registered fungicide program under expert supervision
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit
Diagnosis is uncertain, several plants are affected, or initial management fails

symptoms: Yellow-green streaks become oval grey-centred spots
prevention: Use clean plants and wider spacing
Improve drainage and remove infected leaf material
treatment: Remove heavily spotted leaves without over-defoliating
Use locally registered fungicides with mode-of-action rotation
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit
Diagnosis is uncertain, several plants are affected, or initial management fails

symptoms: Dark green dot-dash streaks appear on veins and petioles
Leaves become narrow, upright, and bunched at the top
prevention: Inspect new plants and manage banana aphid vectors
treatment: Destroy infected mats under local guidance and control vectors
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit
Diagnosis is uncertain, several plants are affected, or initial management fails

symptoms: Reddish or dark spindle-shaped streaks occur on bracts and pseudostems
Leaves may show mosaic and bunches may be malformed
prevention: Remove volunteer hosts and manage aphid vectors
treatment: Remove infected mats and do not use their suckers
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit
Diagnosis is uncertain, several plants are affected, or initial management fails

symptoms: Fruit pulp turns brown and vascular tissue discolours; bacterial ooze may occur
prevention: Use clean tools and planting material
Disinfect cutting tools and control insect transmission from male flowers where locally advised
treatment: Quarantine affected mats and report suspected outbreaks
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit
Diagnosis is uncertain, several plants are affected, or initial management fails
